topics.lead: Most legal problems start as ordinary ones: a salary that didn't arrive, a deposit that never came back, a complaint the police wouldn't write down. Start with yours.

work.title: Work and wages
work.body: Unpaid salary, gratuity, provident fund, notice periods.

police.title: Police and safety
police.body: Filing an FIR, your rights on arrest, protection from domestic violence.

process.title: How an answer gets made
process.s1Title: Your question is matched to the law
process.s1Body: Vidhi searches 72,771 passages two ways at once: by meaning, and by exact words such as section numbers. Questions in other languages are translated first, so every language searches the same library.
process.s2Title: A draft is written from those passages
process.s2Body: The model writes the answer from what the search found and cites where each point comes from. It isn't meant to fill gaps from memory.
process.s3Title: Each claim is checked before you see it
process.s3Body: The draft is broken into individual claims, and each one is compared with the sources. If too many don't hold up, Vidhi searches again and rewrites, up to two more times.

limits.title: What Vidhi can't do
limits.l1Body: It can explain what an act says. It can't tell you how a court will see your case.
limits.l2Body: Only a handful of state acts are in the library, from Delhi and Maharashtra. Local rules and very recent notifications may be missing.
limits.l3Body: Read the cited sections yourself, and speak to an advocate before you act on anything important.
limits.l4Body: A new answer usually takes 20 to 40 seconds, because it's checked before you see it. Repeat questions come back almost instantly.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.a1: Yes. You can get 5 answers without an account. A free account removes that limit, unlocks Deep Search and saves your chats.
faq.q2: Can I ask in my own language?
faq.a2: Yes. Choose from 11 languages in the menu at the top. Type or speak your question, and the answer comes back in the language you've chosen.
faq.q3: Where do the answers come from?
faq.a3: From the text of 494 official documents: central acts and codes, rules, government guidelines and landmark judgments. Every answer lists the sections it relied on, and you can browse the full list in the library.
faq.a4: No. Vidhi explains what the law says in general terms. For your own situation, especially anything involving a court, a deadline or money, talk to a licensed advocate.
faq.q5: What happens to what I type?
faq.a5: Your question is sent to our language model provider, Ollama Cloud, to write the answer. Checked answers are cached for 7 days so repeat questions are faster. With an account, your chats are stored on our server for 90 days. Please leave out names, phone numbers and ID numbers.
faq.q6: Why does an answer take a while?
faq.a6: Vidhi searches, writes a draft, then checks each claim against the sources before it finishes. That usually takes 20 to 40 seconds. Questions it has answered before come back almost instantly.
faq.q7: How up to date is the law in Vidhi?
faq.a7: The library is updated by hand, so recent amendments can be missing. Check the date on any section you plan to rely on.
faq.a8: A slower mode for questions that span several laws. Vidhi breaks the question into steps, searches for each one and shows you what it's looking up. It needs a free account.

cta.title: Have a question about your rights?
cta.body: Ask it the way you'd ask a friend. Vidhi will find the law that applies and show you where it says so.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Last updated September 2026. By using Vidhi, you agree to these terms.
terms.s1Body: Vidhi is a free, independent tool that explains Indian law in plain language using a library of official documents. It is not a law firm and does not provide legal services.
terms.s2Body: Answers are general information about what the law says. Don't use them in place of advice from a licensed advocate, and don't present them to courts or authorities as legal opinions.
terms.s3Body: Don't try to overload the service, get around usage limits, get into other people's accounts, or use Vidhi to harass anyone. We may block access that puts the service or other people at risk.
terms.s4Body: Vidhi runs on personal hardware and a free language-model tier. It may be unavailable, slow or wrong, and the library may miss recent changes to the law. It is provided as is, without warranties.
terms.s5Body: As far as the law allows, the people who build Vidhi aren't liable for losses that come from relying on its answers. Check anything important against the official text and with a professional.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What Vidhi collects, where it goes and how long it stays. Last updated September 2026.
privacy.s1Body: Your chats stay in the open browser tab and are gone when you close or reload it. The browser keeps a small counter of how many free answers you've used, plus your language and theme settings.
privacy.s2Body: We store your name, your email address and a salted hash of your password, never the password itself. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name and verified email. Your chats are stored on our server and deleted 90 days after your last activity, or straight away when you delete them in Settings.
privacy.s3Body: To write an answer, your question and the recent conversation are sent to our language model provider, Ollama Cloud. Answers that pass checking are cached for 7 days and can be reused for near-identical questions from anyone, so please don't include names, phone numbers, addresses or ID numbers.
privacy.s4Body: We keep aggregate counts, such as how many questions were asked each day and how often answers needed revising. We don't store the text of your questions for analytics. If you rate an answer, the rating is stored with an anonymous chat ID. To prevent abuse, we briefly count requests per IP address.
privacy.s5Body: Vidhi has no advertising, no third-party analytics and no tracking cookies. The site is served by Vercel and reaches our server through Tailscale. The only other outside services are Google Fonts, Google sign-in if you choose it, and the language model provider.
privacy.s6Body: You can download or delete your chats at any time, and delete your account from Settings. Deleting your account removes your profile and saved chats immediately. We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Please read this before relying on anything Vidhi tells you.
disclaimer.s1Body: Vidhi provides general legal information. It is not a law firm, and using it doesn't create a lawyer–client relationship. Under the Advocates Act, 1961, only enrolled advocates can practise law.
disclaimer.s2Body: Answers are written by a language model from retrieved passages and checked automatically, but mistakes still get through. Always read the cited sections yourself.
disclaimer.s3Body: Vidhi covers 494 documents, mostly central acts and rules. Most state laws, local regulations and recent amendments are not included.
disclaimer.s4Body: If your situation involves a court case, a deadline, police action or a significant sum of money, speak to a licensed advocate. Free legal aid is available through your District Legal Services Authority, or call the NALSA helpline on 15100.
